title: The God of All Comfort, Paul's Change of Plans

questions.question: Who joins Paul in greeting the church of God that is at Corinth?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God that is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:"

questions.question: Paul blesses the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, calling him the Father of mercies and God of all ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:3 (ESV): "Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,"

questions.question: God comforts us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to ____ those who are in any affliction.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:4 (ESV): "who comforts us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, with the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God."

questions.question: For as we share abundantly in Christ's ____, so through Christ we share abundantly in comfort too.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:5 (ESV): "For as we share abundantly in Christ's sufferings, so through Christ we share abundantly in comfort too."

questions.question: Paul speaks of an affliction they experienced in ____, where they were so utterly burdened beyond their strength that they despaired of life itself.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:8 (ESV): "For we do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the affliction we experienced in Asia. For we were so utterly burdened beyond our strength that we despaired of life itself."

questions.question: Why did they feel they had received the sentence of death?
options: To make them rely not on themselves but on God who raises the dead
Because of the plotting of the Jews
So that their faith would be tested like gold in the fire
To silence the false apostles among them
questions.correctAnswer: To make them rely not on themselves but on God who raises the dead
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:9 (ESV): "Indeed, we felt that we had received the sentence of death. But that was to make us rely not on ourselves but on God who raises the dead."

questions.question: Paul says, "He delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us. On him we have set our ____ that he will deliver us again."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:10 (ESV): "He delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us. On him we have set our hope that he will deliver us again."

questions.question: You also must help us by ____, so that many will give thanks on our behalf for the blessing granted us through the prayers of many.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:11 (ESV): "You also must help us by prayer, so that many will give thanks on our behalf for the blessing granted us through the prayers of many."

questions.question: Paul boasts that they have behaved in the world with ____ and godly sincerity, not by earthly wisdom but by the grace of God.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:12 (ESV): "For our boast is this, the testimony of our conscience, that we behaved in the world with simplicity and godly sincerity, not by earthly wisdom but by the grace of God..." (Some manuscripts have holiness instead of simplicity)

questions.question: Paul originally planned to visit them on his way to Macedonia, and again on his return, to bring them a ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:15 (ESV): "Because I was sure of this, I wanted to come to you first, so that you might have a second experience of grace."

questions.question: Was Paul vacillating when he made these plans? Do I make my plans according to the flesh, ready to say ____ at the same time?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:17 (ESV): "Was I vacillating when I wanted to do this? Do I make my plans according to the flesh, ready to say 'Yes, yes' and 'No, no' at the same time?"

questions.question: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, whom we proclaimed among you, was not Yes and No, but in him it is always ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:19 (ESV): "For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, whom we proclaimed among you, Silvanus and Timothy and I, was not Yes and No, but in him it is always Yes."

questions.question: For all the promises of God find their ____ in him [Christ]. That is why it is through him that we utter our Amen to God for his glory.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:20 (ESV): "For all the promises of God find their Yes in him. That is why it is through him that we utter our Amen to God for his glory."

questions.question: God has put his seal on us and given us his ____ in our hearts as a guarantee.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:22 (ESV): "and who has also put his seal on us and given us his Spirit in our hearts as a guarantee."

questions.question: Why does Paul say he did not come to Corinth as planned?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 1:23 (ESV): "But I call God to witness against me—it was to spare you that I refrained from coming again to Corinth."

key_verse_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, with the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
